nodes.label: Shadow.frag (empty depth-only fragment shader)
nodes.rationale: Deliberately empty: the shadow render pass has no colour attachment and depth is written by fixed-function hardware, but Pipeline::init always links a fragment module, so a minimal valid one must exist.

nodes.label: Depth-only shadow render pass
nodes.rationale: RPShadow has no colour attachment at all; depth is written by the fixed-function stage from gl_Position.z, leaving no per-pixel value for a fragment shader to compute.
